title: Community Care Day Planning
content: Meeting notes with Helping Hands United representative Sarah on 15th February. Discussed logistics, volunteer assignments, and promotional materials. Need to finalize the list of volunteers and get confirmation from the church's board.

title: Counseling Session Notes
content: Confidential: Session with Michael R. on 10th February. Expressed concerns about his family's financial struggles and is looking forward to the support from the Community Care Day event. He hopes to find resources for his job search during the event.

title: Parishioner Feedback on Community Events
content: Collected after Sunday service. Parishioners are excited about the upcoming Community Care Day. They hope to see more events like this. Jane D. mentioned that these events make her feel more connected to the community and less isolated in her struggles with mental health.

title: Community Care Day Planning
content:
Community Care Day Planning

Date: March 15th, 2022
Location: St. Mary's Parish Hall and Grounds

Objective: To bring together the community and provide support through various services such as free meals, health check-ups, job fair, and family activities.

Agenda:
- Opening ceremony with a speech by John Doe
- Distribution of clothes and food to the needy
- Free medical check-ups by volunteer doctors and nurses
- Job fair with local businesses participating
- Activities for children and families

Volunteers:
- List of volunteers from the parish community (to be confirmed)
- Volunteers from Helping Hands United (confirmed)

Promotion:
- Flyers to be distributed in the community
- Announcement during church services
- Social media posts by Helping Hands United

Notes:
- Need to finalize the list of volunteers from the church
- Confirm the availability of the parish hall with the church's board
- Arrange for additional tables and chairs for the job fair
- Coordinate with local businesses for job fair participation
- Ensure there are enough materials for children's activities

John's Personal Notes:
- Remember to keep the event inclusive and respectful of all community members
- Follow up with Michael R. about his job search and offer support
- Check in with Jane D. and ensure she has the resources she needs

Next Steps:
- Final meeting with Sarah from Helping Hands United to go over the final details
- Send out a reminder to all volunteers to confirm their participation
- Prepare the opening ceremony speech
